content.value_statement: Medical device teams must align submissions, quality systems, HIPAA safeguards, and cybersecurity plans. This skill structures FDA pathway planning, compliance checks, inspection readiness, and regulatory documentation.
actual_capabilities: Compares 510(k), De Novo, and PMA pathway considerations for medical device planning.
Outlines FDA submission preparation steps, evidence needs, and review response work.
Reviews QSR topics such as design controls, CAPA, document control, and management responsibility.
Maps HIPAA safeguards and PHI data-flow questions for connected medical devices.
Frames FDA cybersecurity, SBOM, vulnerability disclosure, and post-market monitoring work.
Supports inspection readiness and warning letter response planning.
limitations: It does not replace qualified regulatory, legal, clinical, or quality system professionals.
It cannot submit filings, contact FDA, certify HIPAA compliance, or approve medical devices.
FDA and HIPAA guidance changes often, so users must verify current requirements.
The repository includes placeholder scripts, references, and assets rather than the named tools.

use_cases.title: Select an FDA pathway
use_cases.description: Compare 510(k), De Novo, and PMA options before planning evidence and meetings.

use_cases.title: Check QSR readiness
use_cases.description: Review design controls, CAPA, document control, and management responsibility before an inspection.

use_cases.title: Align privacy and cybersecurity
use_cases.description: Map PHI, HIPAA safeguards, SBOM needs, and vulnerability response for connected devices.

prompt_templates.title: Identify FDA Pathway
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this medical device concept and compare likely 510(k), De Novo, and PMA pathways. Ask for missing details before giving a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Review QSR Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our quality system notes for 21 CFR 820 gaps. Focus on design controls, CAPA, document control, and management review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before an internal audit or inspection.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Q-Sub Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Q-Sub meeting plan for this device. Include key FDA questions, needed evidence, risks, and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build Integrated Compliance Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a regulatory, HIPAA, cybersecurity, and inspection readiness strategy for this connected medical device. Separate assumptions from required confirmations.

output_examples.input: A team asks whether a diagnostic software product may need a 510(k).
output: A pathway comparison with stated assumptions.
A list of missing classification and intended-use details.
Suggested evidence areas and FDA interaction questions.

output_examples.input: A quality manager asks for inspection readiness review support.
output: Design control, CAPA, document control, and training gaps.
Owners and next actions for readiness work.

output_examples.input: A connected device team asks about PHI and cybersecurity obligations.
output: HIPAA safeguard questions and documentation needs.
FDA cybersecurity planning items, including SBOM and vulnerability response.

best_practices: Provide device description, intended use, software functions, patient population, and data flows.
Validate recommendations against current FDA guidance and qualified regulatory counsel.
Track assumptions, evidence gaps, owners, and dates for each compliance action.
anti_patterns: Treating pathway suggestions as final legal or FDA advice.
Using outdated predicates or guidance without verification.
Expecting the placeholder scripts or assets to run complete compliance checks.

faq.question: Can this skill file FDA submissions?
faq.answer: No. It can organize submission planning and response work, but users must file through official FDA processes.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports regulatory analysis and documentation, but qualified counsel or consultants should confirm final decisions.

faq.question: Can it assess HIPAA compliance?
faq.answer: It can map PHI flows, safeguards, and risk assessment questions. It cannot certify HIPAA compliance.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide device description, intended use, software functions, patient population, data flows, prior testing, and quality system records.

faq.question: Are helper scripts included?
faq.answer: Only placeholder example files are present. The named FDA and HIPAA scripts in SKILL.md are not included.

faq.question: Can it support SaMD products?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers SaMD classification, software lifecycle documentation, cybersecurity planning, and change control considerations.
